degree_rationale: The cloud and three causes of rain/storm — clouds rising from fire (Virgin's gaze, archons broken/struck), from water (gloom-wind purification, archonic damage to ships), from joined-air (against Virgin's icon). Plus a fourth cloud: from the Light, releasing whole archons. Illumines meteorological mystery.
direction_rationale: Wisdom illumining clouds, storms, lightning as cosmic-spiritual phenomena. The bright phenomenology of weather as cosmic action.
grand_man_function: Natural meteorological illumination — clouds and storms as cosmic operations.
title: The cloud and the three causes of rain/storm in the cosmos
